cand.title: IAS 2027, 14th IAS Conference on HIV Science

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Ariane Brusselmans, IAS Director, Conferences, is the most directly relevant named conference-management stakeholder. Birgit Poniatowski, IAS Executive Director, provides senior organizational escalation. Carole Beilleau, Director, Development and Partnerships, is a secondary partnership route, not an evidenced hotel buyer. MCI Suisse SA is the verified housing operator, but no named individual housing buyer was verified. None of these sources establishes personal hotel-contract signing authority.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming and inside the requested horizon: IAS 2027, Geneva, Switzerland, 12–15 July 2027, with virtual participation. Correct the prior 11 July start: the IAS announcement explicitly says dates were updated on 18 February 2026. The combined HIV Science Geneva programme runs 10–15 July; HIVR4P runs 10–12 July and shares 12 July with IAS. These are not all IAS activity dates. Around 5,000 people from more than 130 countries are expected; this is not a confirmed in-person count.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied hotel specifications: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a 237-room Founex/La Côte hotel, not a downtown Geneva property or a resort. Its six meeting rooms and approximately 250-theatre maximum cannot host this roughly 5,000-person congress. Airport-corridor geography permits only a conditional satellite lodging or small ancillary-meeting proposition, not primary congress housing. A test offer of approximately 20–120 rooms is a hotel-side sales range, NOT published event demand. Banquet/catering capacity remains unverified. Crucially, accommodation is already bureau-managed, so uncontracted overflow cannot be presumed.
findings.venueCommitments: Confirmed: Palexpo congress centre and Halls 2 and 3, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory: Geneva Airport corridor / Grand-Saconnex, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte and not downtown Geneva. This is a congress/exhibition venue, not a competing hotel. IAS says it is “Located next to Geneva Airport”. No hotel meeting-venue substitution opportunity is evidenced.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified biennial science-conference sequence: Mexico City 2019; Berlin/virtual 2021; Brisbane 2023; Kigali 2025; Geneva 2027. IAS publishes a global rotation policy across five world regions, with no consecutive in-person conferences in a region. This is not a recurring Geneva event. No official IAS 2029 dates/city/venue announcement was located; do not promote an inferred 2029 edition to announced status.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Centrally organized housing is already established. IAS states: “the Accommodation team (MCI Suisse SA, the official housing provider for HIV Science Geneva 2027), has pre-blocked hotel rooms in Geneva” and refers to “officially contracted hotels”. Delegate accommodation bookings open 17 November 2026; this is not an open hotel-procurement RFP. MCI handles groups of two rooms or more and booking changes/cancellations; IAS says “Hotels will not accept any changes or cancellations directly.” Additional dynamic-rate options are through MCI partner Nuitée, up to five rooms per reservation. Public IAS accommodation text names no individual hotel properties; the linked conference-account page requires account creation/sign-in, and a complete official hotel roster/allotment was not recoverable. Verified named incumbent properties: none established, not evidence that none exist. Operational channel: accommodation@iasociety.org; +41 22 339 9601.
findings.organizationStructure: Event owner/organizer: IAS – the International AIDS Society, an independent not-for-profit Swiss association under Articles 60 et seq. of the Swiss Civil Code, headquartered in Geneva. It is not a corporate meetings/incentives owner; classify as an association scientific conference. Palexpo is the committed venue. MCI Suisse SA is the official housing provider; this does not establish that MCI owns the event or is the full-service PCO. Nuitée is an additional accommodation platform.
findings.competitiveLimitations: IAS already has MCI-contracted hotels selected for venue proximity and convenience, plus negotiated rates and a Geneva Transport Card. Individual competing hotel names and room allotments were not verified. No sourced sell-out, unmet demand, room shortage, overflow requirement or YOTEL allocation was found. The independent CongressBookers hotel list is not evidence of official IAS/MCI commitments and is excluded from the incumbent roster. IAS promises transport within Geneva and airport-to-accommodation use, not a Founex transfer or La Côte shuttle.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First contact MCI’s published accommodation team at accommodation@iasociety.org / +41 22 339 9601: ask whether YOTEL is already in the 2027 inventory, obtain the full property list and allotments, and ask whether additional suppliers or separately bookable groups are accepted. Offer only a conditional 20–120-room satellite proposal with validated transport and meal logistics, not an assertion of demand. If MCI has no entry route, approach Ariane Brusselmans through IAS for independently commissioned small meetings; use Birgit Poniatowski only for appropriate senior relationship escalation. Do not displace the appointed bureau or sell the congress venue.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Conditional / low-priority for direct hotel capture: 2027 dates and Palexpo are confirmed, but official lodging is already channelled through MCI. No open RFP or request for extra hotels was located. A bureau-inclusion enquiry is legitimate; direct overflow demand is not established. IAS says the transport card can be used “to reach your accommodation from the airport”, but this does not prove actual delegate routing or lodging toward Nyon/La Côte, nor coverage of Founex. Lausanne/French-border travel tests are not applicable because the venue is in the Geneva Airport corridor.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Relationship-led, not a dated future local demand opportunity. Historical global rotation does not support assuming another Geneva science congress in 2029 or within the horizon to June 2028. Inference: use IAS/MCI relationships to test separately commissioned small workshops, staff/project stays or future Swiss programmes only if named demand emerges. No such local programme or hotel RFP was verified.
